out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: bean sprouts
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. PIC was informed to keep and update log records on daily basis to maintain Time as a Public Health Control. PIC provided end points.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Observed plastic containers/cups used to dispense from bulk containers of salt, rice, flour ant etc.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS instructed management to remove the plastic cups and provide food scoops that have handles. The handles shall set up, out of the food. PIC removed plastic cups from bulk containers of salt, rice, flour and etc.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Design/Construction
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not designed or constructed to be easily cleanable: Construction: Soda crates next to 1 DR beverage cooler observed used for raising soda plastic containers from floor.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces shall be free of unnecessary ledges, projections, and crevices, and designed and constructed to allow easy cleaning and to facilitate maintenance. PIC placed all soda cases on designated and approved storage racks.

out_items.name: No bare hand contact with ready-to-eat food, or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed

violations.title: No Bare Hand Contact with RTE Foods
violations.observation: Food employee was observed handling the following ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands: OBSERVED EMPLOYEE GRAB COOKED NOODLES WITH BARE HANDS.
violations.corrective_action: Except when washing fruits and vegetables, food employees may not contact ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands. Employees shall be using suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, or clean disposable gloves to handle all ready-to-eat foods. Proper handling of food and effective handwashing procedures will help prevent foodborne illness. EHS PROVIDED EDUCATION ON PROPER HANDWASHING/BARE HAND CONTACT. PIC DISCARDED OF COOKED NOODLES DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED EDUCATION ON PROPER HANDWASHING AND NO BARE HAND CONTACT CONTINUES.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located IN THE BACK KITCHEN was blocked BY A TABLE AND LARGE POT OF RICE COOKING, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. PIC MOVED TABLE/POT DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS HANDWASHING SINKS MUST ALWAYS BE PROPERLY SUPPLIED AND ACCESSIBLE.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Eggs Stored at 45F or less
violations.observation: Observed an ambient air temperature above 45F in the following refrigeration unit holding raw shells eggs: OBSERVED TWO LARGE BOXES OF RAW SHELLED EGGS STORED ON SHELF IN BACK KITCHEN FOR APPROXIMATELY 2 HOURS.
violations.corrective_action: Shell eggs that have not been treated to destroy Salmonella shall be stored in refrigerated equipment that maintains an ambient temperature of 45F or less. PIC MOVED EGGS TO WALK-IN COOLER. PIC UNDERSTANDS EGGS MUST BE UNDER TEMPERATURE CONTROL.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED SHREDDED CABBAGE AT 52F, COOKED NOODLES AT 60F, AND BEAN SPROUTS AT 64F ON COUNTER-TOP FOR APPROXIMATELY AN HOUR.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC MOVED FOOD ITEMS TO WALK-IN COOLER TO RAPIDLY COOL. PIC UNDERSTANDS THESE FOODS MUST BE UNDER TEMPERATURE (BELOW 41F) OR TIME (DISCARDED AFTER 4 HOURS) CONTROL. HUNAN CAFE (Inspection Date: 10/29/2024) Page 2 of 3
